title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30882v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is credited with teaching reasoning models to write {wait} before reconsidering a step, yet large RL accuracy gains do not require the word. This view can confuse what RL discovers with what a model inherits from its training data. We trace the word through open models' training histories, reading it with label-free indices of frequency, position, form and usage and an injected-error test, all computed from sampled outputs. We find that zero-RL almost never coins the marker: on bases that lack the word, RL raises MATH-500 accuracy substantially while {wait} stays near absent. It arrives with training data: mid-training in OLMo-3, and fine-tuning on reasoning traces installs it in most models whose base lacks it. translated_title: 承袭而非发明：追溯推理模型中“Wait”（等一下）一词的来源
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）被认为教会了推理模型在重新审视某一步骤之前先写下{wait}（等一下），然而RL带来的巨大准确率提升并不需要这个词。这种观点可能混淆了RL所“发现”的内容与模型从训练数据中“继承”的内容。我们通过开源模型的训练历史追溯这个词，采用无标签的频率、位置、形式和用法指标以及注入错误测试来分析它，所有指标均从采样输出中计算得出。我们发现zero-RL几乎从不创造这个标记：在缺乏该词的基础模型上，RL虽能大幅提升MATH-500准确率，但{wait}却几乎依然缺席。这个词是随训练数据而来的：它出现在OLMo-3的中期训练中，而基于推理轨迹的微调则将其引入大多数基础模型中原本缺乏该词的模型。在基础模型已经使用该词的情况下，两个已发布的RL-Zero配方（OLMo-3、MiMo）都会使其成倍增加，而来自同一基础模型的无KL正则化的GRPO则不会；OLMo-3的配方会磨损其形式，使其变得更加……
tldr: 研究揭示推理模型中的{wait}标记并非由强化学习发明，而是从训练数据（中期训练与推理轨迹微调）中继承而来，RL只能放大模型已有的使用习惯。
en_tdlr: The "{wait}" marker in reasoning models is inherited from training data rather than invented by reinforcement learning, which merely amplifies existing usage.
